Materials:

* Ice in large styrofoam cooler  
* Ice packs  
* 2 containers: one for tips/extra tubes, one for matrigel stock  
* 1.7 mL tube metal block from heat/cool block  
* \# of tubes needed  
* 1000 uL pipette tips 

Preparation (Day before):

* Put ice packs and metal tube blocks in \-20 C freezer  
* Put matrigel stock in 5 C fridge on ice packs in styrofoam cooler overnight to thaw  
* Calculate the volume of aliquots you want and how many tubes that will take

Preparation (Day of):

* Set heat/cool blocks to 0 C in the hood, add the frozen metal tube blocks from the \-20 C  
* Go get ice from the autoclave room in the styrofoam container   
* In the hood, put pipette tip box in one of the containers on top of an ice pack, fill around the sides with ice   
* In the hood, put an ice pack in the bottom of the other container and fill with ice. This is for the matrigel stock to sit in when aliquoting.   
* Label all the tubes and add them to the cool blocks

![][image1]

Protocol:

* Once tubes and tips are cold, get started  
* Take the matrigel stock out of the 5 C, and swirl it to evenly disperse material. Spray with EtOH and bury it halfway in the ice of the prepared container. The matrigel level should be below the ice but the neck of the bottle should stick out so you can aliquot out of it.   
* Aliquot out the matrigel, switching tips often to ensure they are cold   
* Store aliquots at \-20 C
